scripts.find:duplicates: find . -name "*.sh" -o -name "*.ts" | grep -v node_modules | grep -v .migration-backups | sort | uniq -d

scripts.web: PLATFORM=web react-scripts build && npx serve -s build
scripts.analyze:corrections: pnpm run analyze:web && pnpm run analyze:mobile

scripts.pattern:compatibility: echo '🔗 Analyzing entity compatibility...' && time tsx src/core/error-analyzer/phases/DynamicPhaseSystem.ts analyze src/app/models --compatibility-matrix --verbose --format json,html,md --output ./compatibility-report && echo '✅ Compatibility matrix generated' && echo '📊 Open: ./compatibility-report/index.html'
scripts.phase:quick-fix: pnpm phase:scan && pnpm fix:phase-safe && pnpm type-check

scripts.phase:complete: pnpm phase:backup && pnpm phase:analyze && pnpm fix:phase-all && pnpm test:param-swaps && pnpm phase:report

scripts.quick:fixes: pnpm generate:corrections:quick && echo '✅ Check ./corrections/quick-fixes.md for easy wins (zsh commands)'
scripts.restore:last: pnpm smart:status | grep -A1 'Individual backups' | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f3
scripts.fix:imports:complete: pnpm fix:interface-imports:all --apply && pnpm fix:file:mixed && pnpm fix-imports:safe && pnpm imports:deduplicate && pnpm check:type-imports
scripts.pre-commit:types: pnpm check:types:count | grep -q '^0$' || (echo '⚠️ Type import errors found'; pnpm fix:types:dry; exit 1)
scripts.ci:types-check: pnpm check:types:count | grep -q '^0$' || (echo '❌ Type import errors found'; pnpm fix:types:dry; exit 1)
scripts.types:fix-safe: pnpm backup:create 'Before type fixes' && pnpm types:incremental
scripts.types:fix-entity: pnpm backup:entity DataStore '*DataStore*' '*Store*.ts' && pnpm types:fix namespace-fixer file:src/app/hooks/useDataStore.ts
scripts.types:undo-last: tsx src/app/scripts/smart-backup-system.ts restore $(tsx src/app/scripts/smart-backup-system.ts list | grep 'backup-' | tail -1 | awk '{print $1}')
scripts.fix:types:summary: tsx -e "console.log('\n📊 TYPE IMPORT SUMMARY:'); console.log('='.repeat(40)); require('child_process').execSync('grep -r \"import.*BaseDataEntity.*from\" src/ --include=\"*.ts\" --include=\"*.tsx\" | grep -v \"import type\" | wc -l', {encoding:'utf8'}).split('\n').forEach(l => console.log('Files needing fix:', l.trim()));"
scripts.find:type-errors: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | grep -E "'[^']+' is a type" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
scripts.check:type-errors: npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | grep "is a type" | wc -l
scripts.check:type-imports: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | grep 'is a type' || echo '✅ No type-only import errors'

scripts.dev:correction-roadmap: pnpm run scan:full && pnpm run review:roadmap

scripts.validate:ts-setup: pnpm type-check 2>&1 | head -5 && echo '✅ TypeScript setup verified'
scripts.quality:full: pnpm lint:strict && pnpm analyze:all && pnpm analyze:ts-comprehensive
scripts.fix:types:preview: npm run fix:types:tsc:preview && npm run fix:types:custom:preview
scripts.fix:ts-file: tsc --noEmit --pretty false FILE 2>&1 | pnpm analyze:ts-errors:stdin --output ./file-fixes --group-by type
